news.analysis: Allen tallied his lowest passing yards total of the season, but was able to turn in a solid day with three total touchdowns. Allen has thrown an interception in three straight games and will look to break that streak against Miami in Week 11.
news.contents: Josh Allen completed 11-of-21 passes for 196 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in a 31-12 win over the Jets. He added five rushing yards and two touchdowns on five attempts.
news.title: Josh Allen rushes for two touchdowns in Week 10 win

news.analysis: Allen took a backseat to Breece Hall for the second straight week since Hall's return to the lineup. Allen remains a handcuff at best heading into a Week 11 matchup with the Chargers.
news.contents: Braelon Allen rushed for 40 yards on eight carries in a 31-12 loss to the Bills. He caught his lone target for six yards.
news.title: Braelon Allen sees nine touches in Week 10 loss

news.contents: New York Jets running back Braelon Allen was once again an afterthought in the offense on Sunday. Allen was running wild on opposing defense when Breece Hall was out, but now he's struggling to make a significant impact. In Week 10, Allen carried the ball eight times for 40 yards and hauled in his lone target for six yards in the loss. This marks the second straight week that Allen has been held to under 10 carries. news.title: Braelon Allen Sees Limited Role in Week 10

news.analysis: McMillan led the team in targets with seven, but was only able to convert that into three receptions, his lowest total since Week 2. The 23-year-old will look to bounce back against Baltimore in Week 11.
news.contents: Tetairoa McMillan caught 3-of-7 targets for 35 yards in a 20-17 win over the Saints.
news.title: Tetairoa McMillan hauls in three passes in Week 10

news.contents: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Tetairoa McMillan recorded three receptions (on seven targets) for 35 yards (11.7 yards per reception) and no touchdowns in a 20-17 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 10. While McMillan led the team in targets, he finished third in receptions and third in receiving yards behind running back Chuba Hubbard (five receptions for 80 yards) and tight end Tommy Tremble (four catches for 48 yards). news.title: Tetairoa McMillan Held to 35 Yards Versus Saints

news.analysis: Boston dealt with a toe injury all week, but he practiced Friday and took the field Sunday. The rookie was not able to produce much for fantasy managers, however, finishing with fewer than three catches for just the second time over the last seven games. Boston has had a nice rookie season to this point and should rebound quickly.
news.contents: Denzel Boston caught 1-of-2 targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
news.title: Denzel Boston finishes with just one catch in Week 10

news.analysis: Reichard continues a dynamic stretch to this point, recording six or more points in eight of his nine contests. The kicker will look to offer fantasy managers another impactful performance in a difficult Week 11 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.
news.contents: Will Reichard converted all three of his field goal attempts as well as each of his three extra point attempts to finish with 12 points in the Vikings' 30-10 win over the Packers in Week 10.
news.title: Will Reichard racks up 12 points in Week 10

news.analysis: Penix Jr. has struggled to make an impact behind center of late, throwing one or more interceptions in each of the last three games. The quarterback faces a disruptive Minnesota Vikings defense in Week 12 after the team's Week 11 bye.
news.contents: Michael Penix Jr. completed 23-of-43 pass attempts for 286 yards and one interception while also rushing four times for 29 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 Week 10 loss to the Chiefs.
news.title: Michael Penix Jr. bottled up in Week 10 loss to Chiefs

news.contents: Atlanta Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. began the season with a 9:1 TD:INT over his first five games, but has since thrown just one touchdown and five interceptions over the last two contests. The former first-rounder has failed to go over 200 yards passing in either of those games, and hasn't topped 256 yards all season, although two three-touchdown performances have shown what he is capable of. news.analysis: Williams has struggled to make a sizeable impact on offense, finishing with under 40 receiving yards in four of his five games. The wideout remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of the team's Week 11 bye.
news.contents: Savion Williams caught both of his targets for 27 yards in the Packers' 30-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 10.
news.title: Savion Williams catches two passes in Week 10

news.analysis: Ferguson will sit out after being unable to practice throughout the week, leaving quarterback Dak Prescott without a key intermediate pass-catching option. Brevyn Spann-Ford, James Mitchell, and Luke Schoonmaker will consume the snaps at tight end against the 49ers.
news.contents: Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) is officially inactive for Week 10 for the Dallas Cowboys against the San Francisco 49ers.
news.title: Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) inactive for Week 10

news.analysis: Beck had some nice moments early, including a 31-yard pass to Devin Duvernay. His first interception also came on a dropped pass by Duvernay. He will be a borderline QB2 play next week against the Chiefs.
news.contents: Carson Beck completed 11-of-18 passes for 108 yards and two interceptions in the Cardinals 34-6 loss against the Rams.

news.contents: Arizona Cardinals rookie quarterback Carson Beck struggled mightily in his first career NFL start on Sunday, completing just 11 of 18 passes for 108 yards and two interceptions against the division-rival Los Angeles Rams. On the bright side, Beck looked solid in the first half, but as the Rams took over and started putting touchdowns on the board, the Cardinals found themselves in a situation where they needed to make something happen, and that's when Beck's mistakes came. news.analysis: Taylor saw more targets than fellow TE Kenyon Sadiq in the loss Sunday. Despite that, the target share for the young TE has been fairly inconsistent since returning in Week 5. Fantasy managers can likely find a better option heading into Week 11.
